title: Docs and public pages: phones, page weight, links
items: Docs and comparison pages no longer scroll sideways on phones: breadcrumbs wrap, and long identifiers, URLs and calls in inline code and cards break instead of widening the page (and pushing the cookie banner's buttons off screen)

The SDK API reference is split by topic (requests, emails, forwarding, teams and sharing, types, helpers and errors) so each page loads quickly; links and bookmarks to the old sections still land on the right heading. Code blocks no longer carry their highlighted code a second time as client props, and neither the table of contents nor the announcement banner shifts the page when it arrives
The quick start begins with the guest endpoint the home page creates, and says what signing up adds; mailhooks.cc says why email needs an account
The forwarding docs show how to see a delivery succeed without a server of your own, with `whk share` or `whk tunnel`
`/docs/providers/<provider>` redirects to the provider's page, and the Coinbase Commerce page cites Coinbase's current documentation
`/.well-known/agent-skills` serves the skills index instead of a 404
The `/share/<framework>` guides have markdown twins, at `/share/<framework>.md` and for an `Accept: text/markdown` request
A test checks every internal link and heading anchor in the docs
